name: Grimtotem Horn
summary: Grimtotem Horns are taken from Grimtotem tauren west of Camp Mojache in Feralas. Krueg Skullsplitter asks for them after learning the tribe is nearby.

sections.title: Taken in Feralas
sections.body: West of Camp Mojache, Grimtotem tauren carry these horns. Krueg Skullsplitter asks you to bring him a collection after learning the clan is in Feralas. He says Belgrom has placed a bounty on the Grimtotem and warns that they are dangerous.

faq.q: Where do Grimtotem Horns come from?
faq.answer: Grimtotem tauren west of Camp Mojache in Feralas carry the horns.
Krueg Skullsplitter in Camp Mojache asks you to bring him Grimtotem Horns.
Krueg asks for the horns after learning that Grimtotem tauren are nearby. He says Belgrom has an interest in the tribe and has placed a bounty on them.
The Grimtotem are a tauren clan found west of Camp Mojache in Feralas.

angles.text: As a Horde traveler, Krueg's warning frames the Grimtotem as a danger to Horde lands and villages.
